messages:
Maya C (CS): Quick heads-up — Sparrow pilot cohort (10 seats) needs a tighter feedback cadence. Enrollment done, but only 3 teams have submitted the kickoff survey. I want to run a short 2-week pulse and a live enablement for the low-engagement accounts. Thoughts?
Samir P (AE): Noted. Which accounts are low? I can nudge them and offer a quick 30m office hours slot.
Maya C (CS): Low list: Rook Labs, Meridian Health, Gridline. Usage metrics look like <10 API calls/day for each. Renewal risk signal = medium if we don't show value quickly.
Elaine R (Onboarding): I can run the enablement workshop next Tue 10:30–11:00 PT. Add a quick checklist so participants can prepare (API keys, sample prompts, expected outputs).
Samir P (AE): I'll ping Rook & Gridline owners in the thread + DM. Also recommend we send a pre-work email with 3 suggested integrations to try.
Maya C (CS): Agreed. Draft invite below — pls tweak: ```Subject: Quick Sparrow pilot enablement — Tue 10:30 PT
Hi Team,
We noticed low activity in your pilot and want to run a short live session to help you ship faster. Come with one use-case and your API key ready. Link: <cal.link/sparrow-onboard>
Thanks,
Maya & Redwood CS```
Elaine R (Onboarding): I like it. Add a line about expected outcomes: "ship a working sample in 30 mins".
Samir P (AE): @Harry L can you confirm we have constrained seats for the live? I can open a second slot if folks need it.
onboarding-bot: Enrollment status update — Rook Labs: enrolled, kickoff_survey: pending; Meridian Health: enrolled, kickoff_survey: pending; Gridline: enrolled, kickoff_survey: submitted.
Harry L (Solutions): Confirmed — capacity for two concurrent 30m office hours slots. I'll block Tue 11:30 PT as overflow.
Maya C (CS): OK next steps: 1) Send pre-work email today (Samir) 2) Enablement workshop Tue 10:30 (Elaine) 3) Office hours overflow Tue 11:30 (Harry) 4) Two-week pulse survey goes out Fri (Maya) — include 3 quick success metrics: "got sample working", "latency ok", "accuracy acceptable".
Samir P (AE): Sending pre-work email now. DMing the Rook & Meridian contacts with a gentle nudge + calendar invite. :thumbsup:
Elaine R (Onboarding): Prep deck uploaded: <drive.redwood/sparrow-onboard-deck>. Short checklist at top of slide 1.
Maya C (CS): I'll build the pulse form (3 q's + NPS) and set automation to collect responses and flag accounts with <50% completion for escalations.
Harry L (Solutions): Can we include an integration snippet for Node + cURL in the pre-work email? Cuts friction.
Samir P (AE): Good call — adding a 2-line cURL + Node snippet.
Maya C (CS): After the workshop, we'll run a 7-day follow-up: 1) usage snapshot 2) qualitative notes 3) renewal-risk flag if usage doesn't double. If flagged, we schedule an AE deep-dive.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: enablement workshop scheduled Tue 10:30 PT — attendees: Rook Labs, Meridian Health, Gridline, Sparrow pilot lead.
Elaine R (Onboarding): Thanks team. I'll run the session and capture recording + checklist actions.
Samir P (AE): Sent invites + pre-work. Will report back if any declines.
Maya C (CS): Awesome — will loop in product feedback doc after pulse. If anyone sees additional churn signals before Tue, drop them here.
Harry L (Solutions): I'll monitor logs and post any infra/latency notes.
Maya C (CS): Closing the loop — target: increase active seats to 7/10 by EOW after enablement.
Samir P (AE): On it.
Elaine R (Onboarding): :rocket:
